cli.description: A register of video game playthroughs.

help.start: Open a session for a game.
help.past: File a game finished in the past.
help.status: Vault summary, or one game's state.
help.search: Look a title up without recording anything.
help.alias: Teach another name for a game.
help.amend: Correct an event by appending a patch.
help.revoke: Withdraw an event from the fold.
help.init: Write gamereg.config.json for a new vault.
help.build: Regenerate notes and the consolidated table.
help.doctor: Validate the log and report what is wrong.
help.enrich: Fetch metadata and cover art from a provider.
help.query: Run a read-only SELECT against data/log.db.
help.import: Bulk historical import from a spreadsheet.

arg.target: Build only these targets, from build.targets.
arg.csv_file: Path to the CSV file to import.
arg.platform_synonyms: other spellings that mean the same platform

opt.vault: Vault root (default: $GAMEREG_VAULT or the working directory).
opt.dry_run: Print the events that would be appended; write nothing.
opt.id: Resolve by reference, as game:01K… — no search.
opt.platform: Platform. Filters a search; never resolves it.
opt.form: physical, digital, emulator, subscription, borrowed, cloud, demo.
opt.day_cutoff: HH:MM. When the logical day flips for reporting.
opt.csv_dir: Vault-relative directory for the csv target.
opt.replay: Force a new run even when a closed one exists.
opt.no_metadata: Create a local-only entry from the raw string.
opt.note: Note, in the player's own words.
opt.criteria: credits, true_ending, full_completion, platinum, enough, endless, abandoned.
opt.hours: Stated hours, recorded as stated rather than measured.
opt.set: Field to patch, as key=value. Repeatable.
opt.force: Rewrite every derived file, changed or not. Overwrites seeded bases.
opt.list: Show what this vault declares, and what it wrote.
opt.local_only: Search the log only. Phase 0 does nothing else.
opt.text: Read the review from a file, or from - for stdin.
opt.run: Which playthrough. Defaults to the most recently ended.
opt.provider: Provider to query: igdb, rawg. Default: igdb, then rawg as fallback.
opt.covers: Also fetch and set cover art, unless the cover is source: user.
opt.mapping: Path to a JSON file mapping gamereg fields to CSV column headers.
opt.match: Provider ref to fetch directly, as igdb:7346 — skips search.
opt.platforms: Platforms this vault suggests, comma separated

help.verdict: File the consolidated review of a playthrough.
help.platform_add: Add a platform, with any number of synonyms.
help.platform_remove: Remove a platform from the suggestion list.
help.platform_list: List the configured platforms and their synonyms.

error.enum: {field}: "{value}" is not a valid value. Valid: {valid}.
error.rating: rating: {value} is out of range. Expected an integer from {min} to {max}, or none.
error.bad_date: Could not read "{value}" as a date. Try 2011, 2011-07 or 2011-07-14.
error.bad_duration: Could not read "{value}" as a duration. Try 90, 40m, 2h or 1h20.
error.bad_hours: Hours must be a positive number, not {value}.
error.corrupt_log: {file} has an unreadable line at {line}. Run gamereg doctor.
error.not_found_hint: Nothing on record matches "{query}". Add --no-metadata to open a new entry for it.
error.provider_unavailable: Provider lookup is not available in this version. Use --no-metadata.
error.provider_credential_missing: {provider} is not configured: {missing} is not set, in the environment or in gamereg.secrets.json.
error.session_already_open: A session for {title} is already open, filed at {time}.
error.run_already_closed: The run for {title} is already closed.
error.break_already_open: A break is already open, since {time}.
error.negative_duration: That closing time is before the opening time, or the breaks exceed the session.
error.unknown_event: No event on record has the id "{id}".
error.amend_needs_set: Nothing to amend. Pass at least one --set key=value.
error.cannot_amend_correction: Corrections cannot themselves be amended. Revoke it instead.
error.text_required: Provide the review with -m, with --text <file>, or on stdin.
error.marker_unpaired: {file}: the block "{block}" opens and never closes.
error.marker_nested: {file}: the block "{block}" opens inside another block.
error.slug_collision: The slug "{slug}" is used by more than one game.
error.target_phase: The build target "{name}" arrives in phase {phase}. This version builds phase 0 targets.
error.target_not_declared: "{name}" is not among this vault's build.targets: {declared}. The argument narrows a build; it never defines what the vault contains.
error.target_conflict: The targets "{first}" and "{second}" both plan to write {path}.
error.unimplemented_target: The build target "{name}" is declared but not implemented in this version.
error.missing_template: The shipped template "{name}" is not installed alongside this version.
error.outside_vault: A build target planned to write outside the vault: {path}.
error.no_run: {title} has no run to attach a verdict to.
error.unknown_run: {title} has no run with the id "{id}".
error.vault_exists: {file} already exists. Re-run with --yes to overwrite it.
error.log_db_missing: {file} does not exist yet. Declare "sqlite" in build.targets and run gamereg build.
error.query_empty: Nothing to run. Provide a single SELECT statement.
error.query_multiple_statements: Only a single statement is allowed. Remove everything after the first semicolon.
error.query_not_select: Only a read-only SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) is allowed.
error.query_forbidden: "{keyword}" is not allowed in a query. Only a read-only SELECT is allowed.
error.query_failed: The query could not be run: {message}
error.import_mapping_incomplete: The mapping at {file} has no column for "{field}", which is required.
error.import_row_incomplete: Row has no value for "{field}", which is required.
error.bad_image: {file} could not be read as an image.
error.bad_match_ref: "{value}" is not a provider reference. Expected <provider>:<id>, e.g. igdb:7346.

doctor.not_an_object: Line {line} is not a JSON object.
doctor.missing_envelope_field: Line {line} is missing id, ts or type.
doctor.unknown_event_type: Line {line} has an unknown event type "{type}".
doctor.incomplete_event: A {type} event is missing a required field.
doctor.orphan_reference: A {type} event points at something that does not exist.
doctor.duplicate_game: Game {game_id} is created more than once.
doctor.duplicate_run: Run {run_id} is opened more than once.
doctor.duplicate_session: Session {session_id} is opened more than once.
doctor.run_closed_twice: Run {run_id} is closed more than once.
doctor.session_closed_twice: Session {session_id} is closed more than once.
doctor.break_outside_session: Break {break_id} sits outside an open session.
doctor.break_already_open: Session {session_id} opens a second break while one is open.
doctor.unknown_block: {file}: the block "{block}" is not one this version writes. It is left untouched.
doctor.run_note_prose: {file}: a run note carries text outside its markers ("{text}"). The next build will lose it.
doctor.orphan_artifact: {file} looks generated, but no target owns it. The build will never touch it.
doctor.slug_collision: The slug "{slug}" is shared by {count} games.

prose.dry_run_events: The following events would have been appended:

start.new_run: Filed: {title} ({platform}) — run opened, session opened at {time}.
start.replay: Filed: {title} ({platform}) — certified copy, run {run}. Session opened at {time}.
start.created: A new entry was opened for "{title}". No catalogue was consulted.
start.new_run_unknown: Filed: {title} — run opened, session opened at {time}.
start.replay_unknown: Filed: {title} — certified copy, run {run}. Session opened at {time}.

end.closed: Session closed at {time}. Net duration: {duration}. Game total: {total}.

break.started: Break opened at {time}. {title} remains filed as in progress.

finish.session_closed: The open session was closed at {time} first.

past.hours: Stated duration: {hours} h — recorded as stated, not measured.

open.row_break: {title} — filed at {time}, open for {duration}, on a break since {break_time}.

amend.done: Event {id} amended. The original stays on record.

revoke.done: Event {id} revoked. The original stays on record.

build.done: The register is in order: {targets}, {written} files written.
build.removed: {count} files no longer claimed by any target were removed.
build.failed_count: {count} targets failed. Everything else was written.

doctor.clean: The register is in order. {events} events, {games} games, {runs} runs.

verdict.filed: Verdict filed for {title}. It appears in the note at the next build.
verdict.replaced: Verdict replaced for {title}. The previous text stays in the log.

enrich.skipped: {count} games had no confident match at any provider and were left as they were.
enrich.failed_count: {count} games could not be reached. Everything else was written.

import.failed_count: {count} rows failed. Everything else was written.

platform.inferred: Platform recorded: {platform} — the only one of yours this game exists on.
platform.removed: Removed from the list: {platform}. Nothing already recorded on it was touched.
platform.absent: Not on the list: {platform}. Nothing to remove.
platform.none: No platforms configured. They will be learned as you record them.

prompt.create_new: None of these — open a new entry for "{query}"
